assets.name: carnival-table
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: actual 2D mobile game background, portrait 2:3. An exquisitely crafted fantasy mechanical pinball carnival cabinet, perfectly orthographic overhead view. The large central PLAYING SURFACE is entirely EMPTY, richly textured dark emerald velvet inlaid with very subtle flowing art-nouveau gold filigree only at the perimeter. No pins, no balls, no holes, no circles, no objects in the playfield. A thin polished antique brass raised rail frames a rectangular inner playing area. Center field covers 88% of image width and 88% height. Exterior edge has tiny ruby, sapphire and emerald status lights, intricate cast-metal scrollwork, brass screws, warm amber incandescent bulbs and dark lacquer wood; restrained deluxe arcade craftsmanship, physically believable materials, hand-painted fantasy game art with sharp silhouette. Slight worn patina, emerald luminous shade, warm golden reflections. FULL BLEED, no outside scene, no text, no numbers, no lettering, no UI. Not a photo; production-quality detailed game texture, clean legible empty center. Keep playing field rectangular and same width all the way, no perspective.

assets.name: carnival-props
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production game sprite atlas on a genuinely TRANSPARENT background. Square image, precisely THREE columns by THREE rows, nine separate objects, each centered within its equal cell, no dividers, no labels, no text, no numbers. Orthographic straight overhead view, coherent lavish fantasy brass-and-emerald pinball carnival style. ROW 1: [ruby red round mechanical bumper with an octagonal brilliant gem], [sapphire blue round mechanical bumper with diamond-cut blue gem], [emerald green round mechanical bumper with triangular green gem]. These 3 bumper outer metal rings are identical circular radius, each fills 80% cell. ROW 2: [round golden jackpot bumper featuring a raised ornate crown and small emeralds, embossed solid brass, circular silhouette], [round mechanical bell bumper with amber crystal center shaped as a bell relief, circular silhouette], [small closed treasure chest brass and emerald lacquer, overhead view]. ROW 3: [circular padded inflatable bumper ride pod, brass outer rim, deep green open central seat, empty, no rider, no steering wheel], [single horizontal long thin mechanical spinning paddle with rounded bulb ends and central round jewel pivot, one straight brass bar with emerald rubber edging, width 88% cell and height 22% cell, completely centered], [single horizontal short brass pull-handle wrapped in rich brown leather grip, width 76% cell height 23% cell, no rope]. Hand-painted premium RPG game art, polished gold, fine engraved edges, subtle cast shadow only near each object, consistent upper-left lighting. Each object completely isolated within its own cell with generous clear margin. Do not include any squares of background, reference grid or decorative tile backplates.

assets.name: carnival-poster
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: portrait 2:3 key art for a fantasy party minigame called Human Pinball Carnival. No lettering or UI. Dynamic luxury emerald-and-brass pinball amusement arena, viewed slightly elevated over the playfield, rich cinematic fantasy illustration. A cute azure slime, mischievous small green goblin, tiny gray wolf in a burgundy cape and funny little skeleton ride four round brass bumper pods, ricocheting past big ruby sapphire and emerald pinball bumpers. Centerpiece: magnificent golden crown jackpot bumper erupting in a restrained shower of coins and tiny warm sparks. Brass mechanical spinner, carved gilded cabinet rail, deep green felt, warm festival bulbs, sense of joyous chaotic physical collisions. Beautiful stylized 3D painted game key art, very detailed believable metal and velvet, distinct clean silhouettes, small chibi characters, not flat vector, not anime screenshot. Strong emerald and antique gold palette with jewel colors. Reserve darker low-detail top fifth for game title composited later. No words, no numbers, no logos, no watermark.
